quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this intersection.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and look both ways before going.
Let other traffic go first before you enter or cross.
Keep your speed steady and watch for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic go first before you enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicle, bicycle rider, or pedestrian pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign tell you?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet
The road curves in a series of turns ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone starts after the curve
Drive at least 35 mph around the upcoming curve
Go 35 mph or slower around the upcoming curve

questions.correctAnswerText: Go 35 mph or slower around the upcoming curve
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions right ahead. Speed advisory plaques with these signs show the recommended speed for the curve.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Stop completely and go when it is safe
Only stop to let other traffic pass

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and go when it is safe
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely, let all crossing traffic and pedestrians pass, and then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on the back of slow-moving vehicles that travel below 25 mph. Examples include construction equipment, farm machinery, and horse-drawn vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a stop sign is coming ahead.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down the hill.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that one lane is ending soon and drivers must move to the left lane.

questions.question: This sign indicates that the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road will curve to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. Only vehicles with disability license plates or disability parking placards may park here.

questions.question: Blue traffic signs provide information about:

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services. They tell you where to find rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other helpful services.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your brakes on the hill.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns you of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in or near work areas.

questions.question: This yellow warning sign means:

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It tells drivers to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic laws they must follow. This sign means you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does a red octagon-shaped sign say?
questions.explanation: An octagon-shaped (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. Slow down on wet roads because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: This sign indicates:

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones and let workers or vehicles cross the road.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: When you approach a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you go.

questions.question: What kind of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the start of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the start of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about two-way traffic.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are near a school zone or school crossing. When you see these signs, stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on one-way streets and other roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions you may not see right away. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about an upcoming intersection so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging onto the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Slow down and watch for children. Follow the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers what traffic laws apply in that area. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws to follow. Where this sign is posted, you cannot make a right turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to situations ahead. This sign means the right lane is ending and traffic will merge.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red light. You must stop and wait for a signal that allows you to turn in the direction you want to go.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp curve or a narrow road ahead. You may see these signs on curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers what traffic laws apply in that area. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that people may be crossing the road ahead. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the divided roadway is ending. Traffic will soon move in both directions on the same road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down to a safe speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic from the right will be joining your lane. Be ready to let traffic merge in safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to a safe speed for these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right. Making a right turn here is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that road work is ahead. Stay alert and watch for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it is orange, and at night it looks like a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and get ready to yield or stop before you turn left or right.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Stop before the crosswalk if there is no stop line. Stop before the intersection if there is no crosswalk. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. These include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: Signs with a red circle and line through a symbol mean that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate conditions. This sign tells you to be ready for traffic merging from the right.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this road sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The traffic light is about to change to red.
The traffic light is about to change to green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The traffic light is about to change to red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns that the signal will change to red soon. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through it.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to an abrupt change in direction ahead. Slow down and prepare for a sharp turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Make space for drivers to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Make space for drivers to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where animals, people, and vehicles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because the pavement becomes slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means you must stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A downgrade or hill is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downgrade or hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a dangerous hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then go.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before going.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop and look in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. These signs tell drivers to watch for bicycles that may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is ahead. Slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left at this intersection.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns you that a divided roadway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on any road. You must come to a complete stop. Wait until it is safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What do orange background signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used only for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: You see this sign at a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At this railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road splits. You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits. You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns you that the road splits ahead. You must bear either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let cross traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: At this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop if needed before going ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean there is work zone activity ahead. This sign warns you that a flagger is coming. You must obey the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way road and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic is merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell you about road conditions ahead. They warn of curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A red octagonal sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign pointing downward means yield. Slow down and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at the marked line.
